rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for destroying forests, especially in environmental or informational contexts.

example.english: Deforestation causes serious damage to the environment.
example.traditional: 森林砍伐對環境破壞好大。
example.jyutping: sam1 lam4 ham2 fat6 deoi3 waan4 ging2 po3 waai6 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when focusing on the physical cutting down of trees rather than the wider land-use change.

example.english: Too much deforestation makes hillsides prone to collapsing when it rains.
example.traditional: 斬樹太多，落雨時山坡好易冧。
example.jyutping: zaam2 syu6 taai3 do1 lok6 jyu5 si4 saan1 po1 hou2 ji6 lam3
